decision.picked: held items carry {text, raw, chunk_id, ready}; text swaps in place when clean answers
decision.why: send_sentences re-slices joined text by sentence so exact per-message raw pairing isn't possible there; send_screen (the default pause-mode path used by the phone test) gets exact raw pairing since it reads the whole box at once
decision.alt: full character-aligned raw/clean diff per outgoing message — too much for a small-budget first slice

headless Playwright proof against the worktree server (127.0.0.1:61276), never the owner's tabs. Built a real composer with revise:"clean" at 400px, called mic.commit() directly with a filler-heavy raw sentence (bypassing Dictate.sample()'s own sampling guard, which intentionally never revises sample text). Box showed raw first, then swapped in place to the fast assistant's clean text ~3-6s later; the raw toggle chip correctly dug back to Whisper's exact words including the doubled "the the". assign.title: Clean transcription mode: the composer's box shows tidied text, raw still one tap away
assign.outcome:
**Clean transcription mode shipped in AI 2's composer** — proof: shots/2..4 (a raw filler-heavy sentence typed in, cleaned in place, dug back with the raw toggle), shots/5-6 (playground's new Clean tab).

- [x] clean mode is the composer's default: `ai2/compose.js` now sends `revise: "clean"`; box shows CLEAN text once the fast assistant answers, raw grey/plain while waiting — shots/2, shots/3
- [x] no strike-through in this view — Corrections/Live moved to the playground's own debug tabs, never shown in the composer
- [x] the message sent is the clean text, raw kept on `entry.raw`/`entry.level` — `Mic.js` `post_held()`; a pending clean-up is awaited up to ~5s, then falls back to raw (`await_clean()`)
- [x] raw stays reachable: a "raw" chip on the composer digs back to exactly what Whisper heard — shots/4
- [x] kill switch: `clean` on/off in the composer's gear panel, on by default, remembered with the other settings
- [x] playground: Clean tab, no marks, now the default; Corrections/Live relabelled "(debug)" — shots/5, shots/6
- [x] `Dictate.sample()` wrapped in try/finally so `this.sampling` always resets

Left for the parent (per the build order, not this brief's job): the fresh-mastermind docs smoke test, `review.mjs`, and the merge.

Left open: deliverable 2's raw pairing is exact for the common "pause" send (the whole box read at once); the rarer sentence-batched send path (`sentences_per_send`/the chunk-length safety cut) sends a whole-message raw string rather than a word-aligned one — noted in `Mic.js`'s own comment on `send_sentences()`.

log.what: Review fixes for findings 1,4,5,6,7 (public/framework/ai/2026-09-29/audio/next-clean-transcription/review.jsonl). (1) Dictate.js revise_chunk now calls on_revised(text,{raw,level,chunk_id}) only on success and a new on_revise_failed({raw,level,chunk_id,why}) on failure - never a falsy text through on_revised, so ext/drawer/rail.js needed no change; fixed the stale prototype comment. Mic.js/ComposerMic split its own on_revised/on_revise_failed to match, added notify_if_failed() called once per send (after await_clean, before the message leaves) instead of once per failed chunk. (4) Playground.js's note above the tabs now says the level touches Clean too, not just Corrections/Live/Side; readme.md matched. (5) Composer.js's hint now reads 'will send raw' (future tense, said once per send via notify_if_failed, not once per failed chunk). (6) Mic.js send_sentences() now puts raw on the first outgoing message of a batch only (raw: i === 0 ? joined_raw : null). (7) the raw chip now hides when SETTINGS.clean is off, live: Mic.js exports CLEAN_CHANGED_EVENT, fired from settings_panel() whenever the 'clean' checkbox changes; Composer.js listens and toggles the chip's hidden state (self-removing the listener once its own root leaves the page, same pattern as Dictate.js's hotkey listener).

Re-ran the same headless proof against the worktree server: clean-mode swap, raw toggle and default Clean tab all still work after the fixes. Added a small proof for finding 7: the raw chip starts visible, hides the instant SETTINGS.clean flips off, reappears when it flips back on - confirmed via CLEAN_CHANGED_EVENT.
